name: Employee Turnover Rate
description: Percentage of employees who leave the organization during a given period; core retention health indicator.
formula: (Number of leavers in period / Average number of employees in period) * 100

name: Employee Retention Rate
description: Percentage of employees remaining with the organization over a specified timeframe.
formula: ((Starting employees - Separations) / Starting employees) * 100

name: Time to Hire
description: Average elapsed days from job posting to candidate offer acceptance.
formula: Sum(Offer acceptance date - Job posting date) / Number of hires

name: Time to Fill
description: Average days to complete the hiring process from requisition open to position filled.
formula: Date position filled - Date position opened

name: Cost per Hire
description: Total recruiting and onboarding spend divided by number of hires.
formula: Total recruiting costs / Number of hires

name: Absenteeism Rate
description: Share of scheduled workdays lost to unplanned absence (sickness or other leave).
formula: (Total workdays lost to absence / Total scheduled workdays) * 100

name: Offer Acceptance Rate
description: Percentage of job offers extended that candidates accept.
formula: (Number of offers accepted / Number of offers extended) * 100

name: Internal Mobility Rate
description: Percentage of roles filled by internal moves or promotions; talent-development effectiveness.
formula: (Number of internal promotions and transfers / Total employees) * 100

name: Training Cost per Employee
description: Average learning and development investment per employee trained.
formula: Total training expenses / Number of employees trained

name: Training Hours per Employee
description: Average formal training hours delivered per employee in the period.
formula: Total training hours delivered / Total number of employees

name: Revenue per Employee
description: Total revenue divided by headcount (FTE preferred); workforce productivity indicator.
formula: Total company revenue / Number of FTE employees

name: Employee Net Promoter Score
description: Likelihood employees recommend the organization as a place to work (promoters minus detractors).
formula: (Percent promoters) - (Percent detractors)

name: Employee Engagement Score
description: Aggregate engagement survey score expressing workforce commitment and motivation.
formula: Average of engagement survey item scores

name: Span of Control
description: Average number of direct reports per people-manager.
formula: Total employees managed / Number of managers

name: Overtime Rate
description: Proportion of total hours worked beyond standard schedules; workload-sustainability signal.
formula: (Total overtime hours / Total hours worked) * 100

name: Workforce Diversity Ratio
description: Share of headcount from under-represented demographic groups.
formula: (Employees from under-represented groups / Total employees) * 100

name: New Hire Retention (90 days)
description: Percentage of new hires still employed 90 days after start date; onboarding quality.
formula: (New hires retained at 90 days / Total new hires in cohort) * 100

name: Promotion Rate
description: Percentage of employees promoted during the period.
formula: (Number of employees promoted / Total employees) * 100

name: Goal Achievement Rate
description: Percentage of assigned performance goals met or exceeded in the review cycle.
formula: (Goals achieved / Total goals assigned) * 100

name: Training Completion Rate
description: Percentage of assigned learning programs completed by employees.
formula: (Training programs completed / Training programs assigned) * 100

name: Process Cycle Time
description: Total elapsed time to complete a single process instance from start to finish.
formula: Process end timestamp - Process start timestamp

name: First Pass Yield
description: Percentage of process instances completed correctly the first time with no rework.
formula: (Units completed correctly first time / Total units entering process) * 100

name: SLA Compliance Rate
description: Percentage of process actions completed within the agreed service-level target.
formula: (Actions completed within SLA / Total actions) * 100

name: Process Throughput
description: Number of process instances or tasks completed within a defined time window.
formula: Count of completed units per time period

name: Process Rework Rate
description: Percentage of process instances requiring rework or correction after first completion.
formula: (Instances requiring rework / Total completed instances) * 100

name: Process Error Rate
description: Share of process executions that result in an error or exception.
formula: (Errored instances / Total instances) * 100

name: Process Automation Rate
description: Percentage of process steps executed without manual intervention.
formula: (Automated steps / Total steps) * 100

name: Cost per Transaction
description: Average cost to execute one process transaction end to end.
formula: Total process operating cost / Number of transactions processed
